title: Align More metronome icon
prompt:
In lib/screens/main_shell.dart, replace the exact lines:
                icon: Icons.timer_outlined,
                label: 'Metronome',
with:
                icon: Icons.av_timer,
                label: 'Metronome',
This matches the existing metronome action icon in song and setlist menus. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -q -F 'icon: Icons.av_timer,' lib/screens/main_shell.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/main_shell.dart && flutter test test/screens/songs/songs_list_screen_test.dart

title: Update Home icon assertion
verify: rg -q -F 'expect(find.byIcon(Icons.av_timer), findsOneWidget);' test/screens/home_screen_test.dart && dart analyze test/screens/home_screen_test.dart
